Inscription of "Chen decay" and "jade orchid" seal.　　The year "Geng Shen" is the ninth year of the Republic of China (1920).　　The picture depicts a peach, a pomegranate and a loquat, each with an orderly jaggedness and fruitfulness. The peach leaves are painted in blue with different shades of ink, and the veins are outlined with heavy ink. The peach fruit is red and green with natural color. The branches of the pomegranate are stiff and stiff, and the small leaves are seemingly random, but they are light and lively, and are set against the heavier peach and loquat leaves, making the picture lighter and heavier, with a sense of rhythm.
